author: Kate King
title: Looking for artist for two pieces of character art
content: I am looking for an artist who has avalibilty right now to draw two pieces of character art. Anyone have an opening? Recs from authors are very welcome. Human artists only, absolutely no AI. Bots and clearly AI content will be blocked. Please only comment below do not DM me. Update: One piece is 2 characters, the other is 3. Will share more info on that privately later as this art is for my new book which is unannounced and I dont want to post too many details publicly. I have no specific style in mind, but would appreciate if you posted an example of your work in the replies. Thank you!! Later update: thank you for all the replies! My PA will be checking through these later today, and I’ll reach out directly to anyone I would like to move forward with.

title: Looking for illustrator for YA fantasy novel
content: 🎨 Calling all fantasy illustrators! I’m looking for an illustrator for my upcoming YA fantasy novel. Think dark academia, ancient magic, mysterious towers and an elegant, atmospheric fantasy aesthetic. ✨ If you create fantasy book covers, I’d love to see your portfolio! Please DM me your artwork, rates and estimated turnaround time. Recommendations are welcome too! #FantasyIllustration #BookCoverArtist #YAFantasy
